ns2:course.label: Strindberg in Translation
ns2:course.description: Major dramas illustrating Strindberg's evolution from Naturalism to Expressionism and one cycle of historical plays; some attention to prose, both autobiographical and non-autobiographical. Same as CWL 464, and THEA 484. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One college-level literature or theatre course, or consent of instructor.
